g.text: point = median over 30 bootstraps at 80% resampling, bar = 2.5-97.5% range, cross = worst replicate.
dotted line = fresh median across clusters (0.965)
top: Wilcoxon markers per cluster (ribosomal and mitochondrial genes excluded from display). bottom: curated program panels, four most cluster-discriminating genes each.
